title: Far-field band (1-3 km) ranking of the nested hide-to-recover surface
lane_paragraph: Reuse H79-NHR nested hide-to-recover HGB surface unchanged (shared gems57 evaluator/writer, gems79.nhr stack). The single new mechanism is a hard placement band: dots may only be placed 10-30 px (1-3 km) from the visible catalogue (holdout) or full catalogue (final), off masked/catalogue pixels, 3 px Poisson spacing, budget 37654 scaled by region area. Surface uniqueness is checked BEFORE final placement; final dots re-checked.
hypothesis: Subsidiary antithetic/synthetic strands 1-3 km from mapped traces carry unmapped-fault kernel credit; restricting a learned discovery surface to that band beats the H33 fold-fair control on hide-and-recover holdout while vacating the near-field dot fields that made H79-NHR a duplicate.
mechanism: Basin-and-Range multi-strand fault zones: subsidiary strands/step-overs within ~1-3 km share strike and offset Quaternary surfaces (lidar scarps in stack).
named_non_fault_mimic: Pluvial Lake Lahontan shoreline/terrace risers and incised channel banks produce contour-parallel steps near range fronts.

fixed_parameters.model: identical to registry/preregistration_nhr.json (HGB 250 iters, lr0.08, leaves63, minleaf200, l2 1.0)
fixed_parameters.training: identical nested hide-to-recover as scripts/run_nhr.py, imported not forked

holdout.split: shared gems57 buffered_component_draw seeds 20,30 buffer3 boundary12
controls: ablation_no_geometry (unrestricted NHR placement, for band cost accounting)

promotion_gate: candidate HOLDOUT-DTI > h33 control both seeds
surface uniqueness before placement: spearman<=0.90 all registry
final dots: spearman<=0.90 and <=70% within 3px of any registry raster (budget-matched-v3)
shared writer PASS: 1-band float32 EPSG:32611 3730x3292 sample transform, finite, [0,1], no NaN in footprint
score_policy: HOLDOUT-DTI labelled with evaluator/n/CI only; ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED only from submission-page receipt.
